SELECT a.region_name AS regionName, COALESCE(SUM(r.ent_count),0) AS entCount FROM sys_area a LEFT JOIN stat_ent_rpt r ON a.region_code = r.region_code
r.deleted = 0
AND a.region_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{req.regionName},'%')
AND r.scale = #{req.scale}
AND r.industry_code IN (SELECT industry_code FROM sys_industry WHERE industry_type = #{req.industryType})
GROUP BY a.region_name

SELECT r.scale, COALESCE(SUM(r.ent_count),0) AS count FROM stat_ent_rpt r
r.deleted = 0
AND r.region_code IN (SELECT region_code FROM sys_area WHERE region_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{req.regionName},'%'))
AND r.industry_code IN (SELECT industry_code FROM sys_industry WHERE industry_type = #{req.industryType})
GROUP BY r.scale
